description: Save a signal alert: a set of filters plus an https webhook. `kind` funding (the default) watches funding_search filters, $0.009 per delivered record. `kind` launches watches launch_search filters (stage, launch_type, domain, company, category, country) and is refused while launches are not available; launch deliveries are not charged while launches are not on sale. `kind` ads watches one company's ads, filters `{domain, platform?, level?}`: its advertiser_started, advertiser_stopped and new_creatives (or, with level `ad`, every ad's own ad_started, ad_stopped and new_creative), $0.006 per delivered event. `kind` events watches a city for NEW events_search matches (filters `city` plus optionally platform, category, min_guests, max_guests, host, speaker, q, free), $0.0015 per delivered event. Each new match is POSTed to the webhook, signed with the returned `secret` (header Prospect-Signature: t=..,v1=HMAC-SHA256). Creating is free; a delivery is charged only when the webhook answers 2xx. The `secret` is shown once. Max 20 active per account.

filters.description: At least one filter of the watched type: funding_search or launch_search filters (date windows and paging do not apply), or for kind ads `domain`, and optionally `platform` and `level` (company, the default, or ad), or for kind events `city` and optionally events_search filters.

name.description: A label, such as 'Series A robotics'.

webhook_url.description: Your https endpoint on a public host.
